note: Set-up: white-side-up diamond. Source: https://origami.me/whale/
1: Precrease the vertical diagonal.
2: Precrease the horizontal diagonal.
3a: Precrease lower-left edge to center.
3b: Repeat on the lower right.
4a: Precrease upper-left edge to center.
4b: Repeat on the upper right.
5a: Collapse the left rabbit ear along the existing preparation creases, with its fin tip toward the upper corner.
5b: Collapse the right rabbit ear; both fins point toward the upper tip.
6a: Mountain fold the upper tip back to the level of the two ear tips (y=1).
6b: Turn over to the plain colored face.
7a: Fold the left corner inward on x=−(√2−1)/2; approximate diagram proportion, tip stays on the horizontal precrease.
7b: Repeat symmetrically on the right.
8a: Fold the right half over the left half.
8b: Rotate counterclockwise so the head is on the left and the tail on the right.
9a: Lower the exposed two-ply fin only. Chosen hinge is 60° to the horizontal; the diagram gives no exact angle.
9b: Turn over to reach the other fin.
9c: Lower the opposite two-ply fin along the mirrored hinge, leaving the body and first fin still.
9d: Return to the source viewing side.
10: Mountain fold the tail behind the body along a 45° crease at x=−0.15 on the top edge. Approximate source proportion; ordinary mountain-fold option, not the optional outside reverse.
